high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "ankurwarikoo," who shared it 23 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a book cover and accompanying text. Book Cover: The book cover is for the book titled "Invisible Women: Exposing Data Bias in a World Designed for Men" by Caroline Criado Perez. The cover design includes a red background with blue silhouettes of human figures, symbolizing women, which are less prominent compared to the larger blue silhouettes of men on the left side of the cover
